findings.title: firstName returns last name instead of first name
findings.body:
The doc comment promises to return "the person's first name", but the implementation `name.trim().split(" ")[1]` returns the **second** word (index 1), not the first (index 0).

For "Ada Lovelace": `split(" ")` → `["Ada", "Lovelace"]`
`[1]` returns "Lovelace" (last name), not "Ada" (first name)

`welcomeBack("Ada Lovelace")` produces "Welcome back, Lovelace!" instead of "Welcome back, Ada!"

findings.title: No handling for single-word names
findings.body: If name has no spaces (e.g., "Ada"), `split(" ")[1]` returns `undefined`, producing "Welcome back, undefined!"

findings.title: No handling for empty/whitespace names
findings.body: Empty strings or names with only whitespace produce "Welcome back, undefined!"

findings.title: Test regex too permissive to catch the bug
findings.body: The regex `/^Welcome back, /` only checks the prefix, not the actual name, so it passes with incorrect output. A more specific test would catch the bug.
